function.name: update_sheet_tab
function.description: Renames an existing Google Spreadsheet tab. Use the exact tab_id returned by get_sheet_info and the new name explicitly provided or confirmed by the teacher. Never invent tab_id or tab_name.

tab_id.description: Numeric tab ID returned by get_sheet_info.

tab_name.description: New tab name explicitly provided or confirmed by the teacher.
